result.finding: No profile-based configuration detected. The rabbitmq-sender uses a single application.properties file with no environment-specific variants, no @Profile annotations in code, and no Maven build profiles. This is consistent with a demo/sample application that relies on runtime environment variable overrides rather than profile switching.
evidence: Only one config file found: src/main/resources/application.properties
No @Profile or @ConditionalOnProfile annotations found in source code
No docker-compose environment variants or Kubernetes ConfigMap per-environment found
values: Runtime configuration via blank property values (namespace, client-id) injected at deploy time
